title: Poppy Watches the Lights Arrive
youtube_title: Poppy Watches the Lights Arrive | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder can be as simple as watching one small light follow another.
summary: Poppy sits on her front step and watches neighbors light their lanterns one by one down the street. The lights arrive like a slow song, and she joins the pattern with her own lamp at the right moment.
